acceptanceCriteria.text: CI change detection exposes explicit host-bootstrap, Nix Runtime, VM, and Appliance ownership classes in addition to the existing non-Runtime classes.
`host-bootstrap/**` alone no longer implies the broad Nix Runtime/VM/Appliance validation class.
Files that define or consume a shared Appliance/VM contract trigger all true dependent classes.
Workflow/config changes conservatively invalidate every class whose selection semantics they can change.
A representative host-bootstrap-only fixture/change proves heavy Nix VM/Appliance validation is not selected.
Representative Nix, VM, and Appliance path fixtures prove the corresponding class is selected.
Required-check/ruleset behavior remains deterministic for skipped classes.
No Runtime validation assertions are deleted in this Issue; only ownership/selection is changed.

issue.title: ci: split change detection by contract ownership
